economy.summary: In his February 2026 campaign announcement, said his campaign will focus on housing affordability, infrastructure investment, civic engagement, and revitalization of the county through sustainable economic development.
economy.short: Campaign focuses on housing affordability, infrastructure, sustainable economic development.

economy.summary: His campaign site says he wants to put more money back in the hands of families and working people by growing businesses and creating jobs in the district.
economy.short: Wants job growth to put more money in families' hands.

taxes.summary: As House Republican Appropriations chairman, said the November 2025 state budget compromise meets spending needs without placing additional burdens on taxpayers, and said it spends more than he would have liked while avoiding a drawdown from the Rainy Day Fund.
taxes.short: Says budget avoids new taxpayer burdens; spends more than preferred.

abortion.summary: Voted in July 2022 for Senate Bill 106, a proposed state constitutional amendment providing that there is no constitutional right to taxpayer-funded abortion; he also co-sponsored a 2021 bill requiring a fetal heartbeat examination before an abortion.
abortion.short: Voted for amendment declaring no right to taxpayer-funded abortion.

education.summary: Said the 2025-26 state budget's addition of $50 million to the Economically Disadvantaged Schools scholarship program was a key improvement, and said increasing school choice opportunities was one of his caucus's three main budget priorities.
education.short: Supports school choice; backed $50 million scholarship program addition.

healthcare.summary: Authored House Bill 1644, which would require behavioral health Medicaid managed care organizations to help hospitals find placements for patients held in emergency rooms, saying Pennsylvania is in a serious, ongoing mental health crisis.
healthcare.short: Authored bill on mental-health patient placements from emergency rooms.

energy.summary: Called the natural gas-powered plant and AI data center planned for the former Homer City coal plant site an incredible new future for the region, and said he is committed to reducing regulatory obstacles and energy taxes to attract similar development.
energy.short: Supports natural gas development; wants fewer regulations, energy taxes.

guns.summary: His campaign site says he will fight for Second Amendment rights to hunt and protect homes and other freedoms.
guns.short: Says he will fight for Second Amendment rights.
